name: Becoming a Parent
summary: In the Hinterlands, Agnar Beastamer has news: the egg is further along than he expected. He wants to speak with you.

sections.title: Sooner Than Expected
sections.body: The egg has advanced further than Agnar Beastamer expected. You have brought food for the hatchling. Now speak with Agnar in the Hinterlands.

sections.title: A Parent, of a Sort
sections.body: Agnar Beastamer gives you the egg so it can bond with you and look to you as its parent. He congratulates you on becoming a parent, of a sort.

faq.q: Who has news about the egg?
faq.answer: Agnar Beastamer has news about the egg. He has been looking after it in the Hinterlands.

faq.q: Where do I find Agnar Beastamer?
faq.answer: Agnar Beastamer is in the Hinterlands.
Before this, you gathered meat for the hatchling in Food for Baby.
